# Files

The commands `mt help` lists under Files. More in [Knowledge](../../../concepts/knowledge.md).

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`file-delete`](#file-delete) | Delete a file from its knowledge base, by id (there is no confirmation; tenant admins only) |
| [`file-download`](#file-download) | Download a knowledge file's original content to your disk (tenant admins only) *(not in the cloud shell)* |
| [`file-get`](#file-get) | Show a knowledge file: its name, type, size and whether it is indexed yet, by id (tenant admins only) |
| [`file-get-by-checksum`](#file-get-by-checksum) | Find an uploaded knowledge file by the MD5 checksum of its content (tenant admins only) |
| [`file-search`](#file-search) | Search a knowledge base for the passages closest in meaning to a query |
| [`file-text`](#file-text) | Print the text extracted from a knowledge file: what search and agents read (tenant admins only) |
| [`file-update`](#file-update) | Replace a knowledge file's content with a file from your disk, keeping its id (tenant admins only) *(not in the cloud shell)* |
| [`file-upload`](#file-upload) | Upload a file from your disk to a knowledge base, to be read and indexed (tenant admins only) *(not in the cloud shell)* |

## file-delete

Delete a file from its knowledge base, by id (there is no confirmation; tenant admins only).

```text
mt file-delete <id>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The file's id (from partition-file-list) |

## file-download

Download a knowledge file's original content to your disk (tenant admins only).

```text
mt file-download <id> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The file's id (from partition-file-list) |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--output, -o <value>` | text |  |  | Where to save it: a file, or a directory to save it in under its own name (default: the working directory) |
| `--overwrite` | flag |  |  | Replace the file if it already exists |
| `--partition-id, -p <id>` | id |  |  | Only find the file in this knowledge base (not found if it is in another) |

**Not available in the cloud shell:** it saves a file to the local disk, and the cloud shell has none. Use file-text to read its text.

## file-get

Show a knowledge file: its name, type, size and whether it is indexed yet, by id (tenant admins only).

```text
mt file-get <id>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The file's id (from partition-file-list) |

## file-get-by-checksum

Find an uploaded knowledge file by the MD5 checksum of its content (tenant admins only).

```text
mt file-get-by-checksum <checksum>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<checksum>` | text | yes |  | The MD5 of the file's bytes, as 32 hex characters |

## file-search

Search a knowledge base for the passages closest in meaning to a query.

```text
mt file-search <query> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<query>` | text | yes |  | What to search for (in quotes if it has spaces) |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--partition-id <id>` | id | yes |  | The id of the knowledge base to search |

## file-text

Print the text extracted from a knowledge file: what search and agents read (tenant admins only).

```text
mt file-text <id> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The file's id (from partition-file-list) |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--partition-id, -p <id>` | id |  |  | Only find the file in this knowledge base (not found if it is in another) |

## file-update

Replace a knowledge file's content with a file from your disk, keeping its id (tenant admins only).

```text
mt file-update <id> <file>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The id of the file to replace (from partition-file-list) |
| `<file>` | text | yes |  | The file with the new content, on your disk (relative to the working directory, or /local/...) |

**Not available in the cloud shell:** it uploads a file from the local disk, and the cloud shell has none.

## file-upload

Upload a file from your disk to a knowledge base, to be read and indexed (tenant admins only).

```text
mt file-upload <file> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<file>` | text | yes |  | The file to upload, as a path on your computer (a relative path starts where mt was started) |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--partition-id <id>` | id | yes |  | The id of the knowledge base to upload to (from partition-list) |

**Not available in the cloud shell:** it uploads a file from the local disk, and the cloud shell has none.
